===== F. ANALYSIS LIMITS =====
1. A direct JAL reference does not prove that the target is a weapon getter.
2. The address 0x00213940 is an interior-looking instruction address.
3. Immediate values 40-44 may be item IDs, weapon IDs, or unrelated constants.
4. Argument setup must be connected to the following call instruction.
5. Delay-slot instructions must be interpreted separately.
6. Embedded data inside executable segments can produce false instruction candidates.
7. No ELF or game memory writes were performed.
8. No weapon attack power field is confirmed by this report.
